title: Degree-one functions are affine
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$ have algebraic degree at most one, with degree defined from its algebraic normal form coefficients. Then there are $b\in\mathbb F_2$ and $a\in\mathbb F_2^n$ such that $f(x)=b+a\cdot x$ for every $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$.
hypotheses_covered: The algebraic degree of $f$ is at most one
